description: ICPAC Geoportal (IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre) is an open data portal listed in ICPAC Geoportal (IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre), a regional geoportal (GeoNode), published or maintained by IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre (ICPAC). ICPAC Geoportal (IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre) is a regional geoportal (GeoNode) of IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre (ICPAC). Coverage: Africa. 584 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 59 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this area. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-icpac-portal.
